statement: Whenever the function returns a result r, the following hold: (1) len(r) >= 1; (2) for every i with 0 <= i < len(r), r[i] is 0 or 1; (3) r = [0] or r[0] = 1; (4) val(r) = val(arr1) + val(arr2), where for any array a of length n, val(a) = sum_{i=0}^{n-1} a[i] * (-2)^(n-1-i).
